EnlightenerAI hardening build verified.

Protocol audit:
- Runtime include/src contains no float, double, malloc, calloc, realloc, free.
- Runtime include/src contains no math.h dependency.
- C89 build passes with -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -ffreestanding -fno-builtin.
- Compiler built with fno-builtin to avoid generated libc helpers such as memset.

Tests passed:
- tests/test_astar.c
- tests/test_perception.c
- tests/test_targeting.c
- tests/test_tactical.c
- tests/test_hardening.c

Hardening applied:
- EAI_Fixed now selects a real 32-bit signed integer type at compile time.
- EAI_U32 now selects a real 32-bit unsigned integer type at compile time.
- Added eai_fx_add_sat, eai_fx_sub_sat, eai_fx_madd_sat.
- Vector add/sub/dot now use saturating math.
- A* g/f cost accumulation now uses saturating math.
- Targeting, perception, memory, tactical scores/timers now use saturating math.
- Bidirectional nav edge insertion now prechecks two free edge slots before writing.
